AI models are now accelerating their own model development twice as fast as they did a year ago.

🤖 Anthropic is using AI systems to build more powerful models, according to a report published by AI safety research organization METR. Following an 11-week investigation, METR found that Anthropic's models are improving roughly twice as quickly as they were a year ago, with little indication of progress slowing down.

⚙️ Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 open-weights fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B. Across Nous's 803-prompt evaluation benchmark, propaganda answers dropped significantly from 22% down to 0.9%. Notably, overall performance on Hermes Bench stayed completely flat at 65.60% during the process.

💬 Shifts in developer tooling are sparking active technical discussions online. A blog post titled "Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi" gained traction on the Hacker News front page, pulling in 282 points and 164 comments as software developers discuss switching between AI assistant tools.

As a software developer, seeing automated development loops accelerate while open-source projects refine evaluation metrics shows how quickly our technical stack is moving. Staying informed on benchmark evaluation, fine-tuning techniques, and model performance is becoming an everyday requirement for building modern software.

Which AI models or development tools have earned a permanent spot in your daily software workflow this year?
